calls.title: GrowthBook <> Brightscout | Weekly Call
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancing the design feedback process by establishing clearer communication and collaboration methods. Kari Kay stressed the importance of direct engagement with designers and proposed daily meetings to streamline feedback. The homepage was identified as a critical area needing refinement, as it sets the tone for the entire site; suggestions included balancing abstract imagery with actual product screenshots. The introduction of copy docs as the single source of truth for content aims to improve consistency and align visuals with text. Additionally, the team committed to a new delivery timeline that allows for a 48-hour review period to enhance feedback clarity and minimize ambiguity. Overall, the meeting underscored the need for actionable feedback and improved communication between teams.
calls.keywords: homepage design, feedback workflow, copy docs, visual assets, design coordination, screenshots
